shortDescription: Saturn Oil & Gas OTC:OILSF said Monday it agreed to acquire privately held Canadian energy company Corex Resources for C$6.31/share in cash and stock, comprised of C$252M in cash and C$50M in Saturn common shares, based on the preceding 20-day volume-weighted average price.Saturn OTC:OILSF said the…

children: privately held Canadian energy company Corex Resources for C$6.31/share in cash and stock, comprised of C$252M in cash and C$50M in Saturn common shares, based on the preceding 20-day volume-weighted average price.

said the acquisition consists of ~7K bbl/day of light oil-weighted, high-netback production in Manitoba which also offer attractive future development locations, including potential open hole multi-lateral targets that are not reflected in the current reserves booking.

The company said it expects to increase its FY 2026 exit production rate to 54K-56K boe/day while maintaining its target exit 2027 net debt to adjusted EBITDA ratio at under 1x; average production guidance for the full year remains unchanged at 43K-44K boe/day.
"This acquisition embodies the Saturn blueprint in action, adding premium oil barrels for only 1.6x times net operating income and ~82% of PDP NPV10 value," Saturn Oil
CEO John Jeffrey said, adding that the barrels being acquired are generating accretive netbacks of $82/bbl and are expected to generate $192M of NOI over the next 12 months at current strip pricing.

title: Saturn Oil & Gas to buy Corex Resources in C$302M cash and stock deal
